name: Ball Games of the World
subtitle: Korfball, Cuju, Croquet & more
shortDescription: 11 ball sports and games to play: Korfball, Netball, Nohejbal and Faustball.
longDescription:
Ball Games of the World: 11 ball sports and games from 15 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Korfball, Netball, Nohejbal, Faustball, Street Stickball, Cuju, Bat and Trap, Croquet, Novuss, Chuiwan and Four Square.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can aim, throw, kick, strike and shoot the ball, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
